title: Bound-Preserving Flux-Corrected Transport Methods for Solving Richards' Equation
summary: Simulating infiltration in porous media using Richards' equation remains computationally challenging due to its parabolic structure and nonlinear coefficients. While a wide range of numerical methods for differential equations have been applied over the past several decades, basic higher-order numerical methods often fail to preserve physical bounds on water pressure and saturation, leading to spurious oscillations and poor iterative solver convergence. Instead, low-order, bound-preserving methods have been preferred. The combination of mass lumping and relative permeability upwinding…
